method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation incorporating amendments up to the Statutes (Repeals and Minor Amendments) Act 2025 (No. 14 of 2025, in operation 26 September 2025); Liquor Control Amendment Act 2025 Pt 5 Div 3 uncommenced; legislation.wa.gov.au law_a649, mrdoc_49053, retrieved 7 September 2026. Public Trustee Regulations 1942, version 04-b0-08 from 1 July 2008 (mrdoc_7511, retrieved 20 October 2026): reg 10A ($1 500 for s 45(2)) and Forms 3-4. Trustee Companies Regulations 1988, version 01-b0-06 from 5 January 2013 (law_s4830, mrdoc_24509, retrieved 21 October 2026): reg 4 ($50 000 for Trustee Companies Act 1987 s 10, which is the s 14 prescribed amount by s 14(6)). The Public Trustee's gazetted scale of fees is not deposited and is an input.

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 2 (client), 7(1), 8, 9, 10(1)(a)-(g) and the (ab) proviso, 10(4)-(5), 11, 12(1)-(3), 14(1)-(2), (4)-(6) with Trustee Companies Regulations 1988 reg 4, 18, 38A(2), 38B(1)-(6), (8)-(9), 45(1)-(2) with reg 10A, 47A(1)-(2), 62; out: the Court's conditions and Gazette notices, s 12(4)-(8), 12A, 13, 16-17, trusts, represented persons, investment, deposit of wills, machinery
seat: the next of kin of a person who has died leaving a small estate in Western Australia (and, for ss 7-8, the will-maker who appoints the Public Trustee executor)
